title: The best Nexera alternatives in 2026
lede: People look past Nexera for one of three reasons: the trial and renewal terms, the price, or wanting practice rather than slides. Here are the alternatives that answer each one, and a few that don't.
keyTakeaways: Iro AI is the closest like-for-like alternative: short daily AI lessons built on practice with feedback, one price billed by Apple, and a free tier.
Khan Academy and Elements of AI are free. Coursera, Google AI Essentials, Sololearn and Brilliant suit certificates, coding and foundations.
Coursiv, Skilario and Jobescape teach similar topics but sell the same way as Nexera's website, with trials and intro offers, so they do not fix a billing concern.
Whatever you pick, find the renewal price and refund terms before you enter a card.
description: Looking for a Nexera alternative? Compare Iro AI, Khan Academy, Elements of AI, Coursera, Sololearn and Brilliant by how they teach, what is free and how you pay.

sections.heading: The best Nexera alternatives
sections.html:
The best Nexera alternative depends on why you are leaving. If you want to keep short daily AI lessons but actually practice with feedback, at one clear price that Apple bills and you can cancel in Settings, Iro AI is the closest fit. If you want it free, Khan Academy or Elements of AI. For a recognised certificate, Coursera or Google AI Essentials; for coding, Sololearn; for math and computer-science foundations, Brilliant.

We make Iro AI, so read this as an interested party. Facts about Nexera come from its App Store listing, its Terms of Use and its Trustpilot page, checked 21 November 2026. Last reviewed November 2026.

sections.heading: Why people look for a Nexera alternative
sections.html:
Nexera is an AI-skills app from Cyprus-based EmberTech Ltd, built around a 28-day AI challenge with courses on ChatGPT, Claude, Midjourney, Zapier and more. The reasons people look elsewhere usually come down to three things:

  • Trials and renewals. On Nexera's website, a trial turns into the plan you picked unless you cancel at least 24 hours before it ends. Most one-star Trustpilot reviews we read are about a renewal the customer did not expect.
  • Price. On the US App Store, Nexera lists $9.99 a month and yearly plans at $69.99 or $59.99. Several Trustpilot reviewers mention paying around 30 euros or pounds a month on the web.
  • Method. A few reviewers describe the courses as mostly slides and theory. Writing your own prompts and getting feedback is what builds the skill.

For the details, see our Nexera review. If you are already subscribed and want out, read how to cancel Nexera first: website purchases have a 28-day money-back guarantee.

sections.heading: Why Iro AI is the closest alternative
sections.html:
Iro AI is our app, so read this as an interested party. If what drew you to Nexera was learning to use AI tools in a few minutes a day, Iro does the same job with a different method: practice instead of slides. You write real prompts in the Prompt Lab and get them scored, spot AI mistakes, and duel a skill-matched opponent, across ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, prompting, agents and automation. It is often called the Duolingo for AI.

On the three reasons above:

  • Billing. Pro is billed by Apple, so you can cancel anytime in two taps in Settings and refunds go through Apple. No trial that converts into a bigger plan you did not notice.
  • Price. Free to start, with a battery that gives you a full lesson every day. Pro is one price: $9.99 a month or $49.99 a year, with a 7-day free trial on the annual plan. The monthly price matches Nexera's App Store plan; the annual plan is $10 to $20 a year less than Nexera's yearly plans.
  • Method. 34 paths, 522 lessons and 3,000+ exercises across 23 exercise types, plus Ask Iro by chat and voice, an Image Lab, timed duels and certificates. It runs on iPhone and the web, and is rated 4.6 stars from 92 reviews.

Iro makes no income or career promises. It teaches you to use AI well, and that is the whole claim.

sections.heading: The rest, one by one
sections.html:
Khan Academy: the free option

The nonprofit covers math, science and computing from basics up, free, and its Khanmigo tutor adds AI help. Pick it if price is the main reason you are leaving.

Elements of AI: free and conceptual

A free online course on what AI is and how it works, made by the University of Helsinki and MinnaLearn. Pick it if you want to understand AI rather than drill specific tools.

Coursera: certificates and structure

University and company courses, including DeepLearning.AI's, with free auditing and paid certificates. Pick it if you want a credential to show an employer, and do not mind longer video lessons.

Google AI Essentials: one well-known certificate

Google's short AI course, sold through Coursera. Pick it if the Google name on a certificate matters to you. See Google AI Essentials alternatives for the trade-offs.

Sololearn: if you also want to code

Bite-size coding lessons with a community, with AI content in its top tier. Pick it if you want to build with AI, not just use it. Head-to-head: Iro AI vs Sololearn.

Brilliant: foundations

Interactive math, logic and computer-science lessons. Pick it if you want the theory behind AI. It lists $24.99 a month or $119.99 a year on the App Store. Head-to-head: Iro AI vs Brilliant.

sections.heading: Apps that sell the same way as Nexera
sections.html:
Coursiv, Skilario and Jobescape come up in every search for apps like Nexera, and they cover similar ground. They also sell the same way as Nexera's website: a quiz-style web funnel, an intro offer or trial, and a renewal at a higher recurring price. If billing is why you are leaving Nexera, switching to one of them does not fix it, and their refund terms are mostly stricter than Nexera's 28-day guarantee.

  • Coursiv: its money-back guarantee pays out only if you used the app enough. See how to cancel Coursiv.
  • Skilario: its terms refuse refunds for a change of mind or an unused subscription.
  • Jobescape: read what its refund terms ask of you before you pay.

sections.heading: How to choose
sections.html:
• You learn by doing and want a daily habit: Iro AI.
  • You want it free: Khan Academy, Elements of AI, or the Iro free tier.
  • You want a certificate: Coursera or Google AI Essentials.
  • You want to code: Sololearn.
  • You want math or CS theory: Brilliant.

Before you subscribe to any of them, take a minute on the checkout page: find the renewal price, the renewal date and the refund policy. Our guide to spotting an AI subscription trap shows what to look for. Or see where your AI skills stand first with the free AI rank quiz, ten questions and about two minutes.

faq.q: What is the best Nexera alternative?
faq.a: It depends why you are leaving. Iro AI is the closest like-for-like alternative: short daily AI lessons built on practice with feedback, free to start, one price billed by Apple. Khan Academy and Elements of AI are free, Coursera and Google AI Essentials give certificates, Sololearn suits coding and Brilliant suits foundations.

faq.q: Is there a free alternative to Nexera?
faq.a: Yes. Khan Academy and Elements of AI are free, and Iro AI is free to start with a full lesson every day. Coursera lets you audit many courses free; certificates cost extra.

faq.q: Is Iro AI cheaper than Nexera?
faq.a: Monthly, they match on the App Store at $9.99. Iro's annual plan is $49.99, against Nexera's $69.99 or $59.99 yearly plans, and Iro has a free tier with a full lesson every day. Iro is billed by Apple, so you can cancel anytime in Settings.

faq.q: Are Coursiv or Skilario good alternatives to Nexera?
faq.a: They cover similar topics, but they sell the same way as Nexera's website, with trials or intro offers that renew at a higher price, and their refund terms are mostly stricter than Nexera's 28-day guarantee. If billing is why you are leaving, they do not fix it.

faq.q: What apps are similar to Nexera?
faq.a: Apps that teach AI tools in short lessons include Iro AI, Coursiv, Skilario, Jobescape and Synapse. For broader learning, Coursera, Google AI Essentials, Sololearn and Brilliant are the common picks.

faq.q: Should I cancel Nexera before switching?
faq.a: Yes, cancel first, at least 24 hours before your trial or period ends. If you paid on Nexera's website in the last 28 days, its terms promise a full refund on request. Our guide to cancelling Nexera has the steps.
